_comment: How dangerous a written Age is, before it exists (design 7.7).
Content rather than config, on the same argument art/manifestation/ is: a pack that makes lava cheap
is a pack where nothing has to be committed to, which is a different mod rather than the same one run
differently. Every number here is a first guess and wants a walk -- read them together, because they
are only meaningful against each other, and `/age danger score <name>` prints the arithmetic.
Blocks and entities are named by id rather than by tag, because a tag binds on a server and this must
be readable offline -- the same bargain Materials.INVALID_FOR_TERRAIN already makes.
`weights` is what share of the score each of the four contributors carries, and they sum to one so
that an Age made of the worst of everything scores about one.
`pays_above` is the one threshold, and it does two jobs: below it nothing pays, and above it the D'ni
ruins are suppressed. UNCALIBRATED -- the working target is about ten Ages to a first ruin.
`spawns_full` and `phenomena_full` say how much asked-for life or weather counts as an Age being full
of it. A scale, not a cap: there is no ceiling, so an Age asking for more scores over one and means to.
`confined_weight` is what a claim confined to one biome is worth against the same claim made of the
whole Age. `wound_hostility` is what a full reach of wounds adds to the hostile population.
`materials` is what an Age's rock, sea or surface is made of. One of these is what you stand on all
day, so the scale is what living on it costs rather than what touching it costs.
`spawns` is what the book asked to live here, over and above whatever its biomes already hold.
`monsters` is what any MobCategory.MONSTER is worth where it is not named -- vanilla already
classifies every creature, so only the ones that are not ordinary for a monster need an entry.
`phenomena` lists the two sights at nothing rather than leaving them out, so that a missing entry
reads as an oversight and this reads as a ruling.
`lighting` counts only insofar as it drives mob pressure. Sealed is worse than merely sunless: a roof
means what walks under it walks at noon as well.
